snippet.title: Skyrim Mod: The Rot Below - Trailer
snippet.description:
A dungeon mod for Skyrim. Discover the secrets of a mad lich who thought themselves a god. You will explore an ancient palace, a subterranean city of the undead, and an insane warlock's research hall. Includes three boss battles, a voice acted story, new weapons, and a host of new enemies. Foil Namira's plans and stop the coming rot.

https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/169298

Narration by Chloë Elmore

Music licensed through Pond5. 
Composer: https://www.youtube.com/@AnthonyLoReMusic/videos
